title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Noodles
teaser: Shrimp and noodles tossed in a quick garlic butter sauce — simple and fast.
steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions and drain.
Melt the butter in a pan and fry the garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Stir in the soy sauce and lemon juice, then toss the noodles through.
Garnish with parsley and serve.

title: Singapore-Style Curry Noodles
teaser: A quick, curry-spiced noodle stir-fry loaded with prawns and vegetables — ready faster than a takeaway.
steps: Soak the rice vermicelli in boiling water according to packet instructions, then drain.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the prawns for 2-3 minutes until pink. Set aside.
Push everything aside, pour in the beaten eggs, and scramble until just set.
Add the pepper and curry powder and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy sauce, and beansprouts, and toss everything together for 1-2 minutes. Return the prawns to the pan and serve.

title: Sesame Ginger Beef Noodles
teaser: Tender strips of beef tossed with noodles in a quick sesame-ginger sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles according to the packet instructions, then drain and set aside.
Whisk together the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and honey in a small bowl.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the beef for 2-3 minutes until browned.
Add the ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the noodles and sauce to the wok and toss everything together for 1-2 minutes until well coated.
Serve topped with spring onions and sesame seeds.

title: Honey Garlic Pork Noodles
teaser: Browned pork mince and peppers tossed with egg noodles in a sticky honey garlic sauce.
steps: Cook the egg noodles according to the packet instructions, then drain and set aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat and fry the pork mince for 4-5 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the garlic, ginger, and red pepper, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until the pepper softens.
Whisk together the honey, soy sauce, and rice vinegar, then pour into the pan and simmer for 2 minutes until slightly sticky.
Toss through the cooked noodles until well coated, then serve scattered with spring onions and sesame seeds.

title: Vegetable Chow Mein
teaser: A quick vegetable-packed noodle stir-fry with scrambled egg and a simple soy sauce.
steps: Cook the egg noodles according to packet instructions, drain, and set aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok and scramble the eggs until just set, then remove and set aside.
Add the carrot and red pepper to the wok and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until just tender.
Add the beansprouts, noodles, soy sauce, and scrambled egg, and toss everything together for 1-2 minutes.
Drizzle with the sesame oil and top with spring onions.

title: Beef Mince Cottage Pie
teaser: A comforting mince and mashed potato bake that's mostly hands-off in the oven.
steps: Boil the potatoes until soft, about 15 minutes, then drain and mash with the butter and milk.
Meanwhile, fry the onion and carrots in a little oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomatoes and Worcestershire sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C). Spoon the mince into an ovenproof dish, top with the mash, and scatter with cheese if using.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden on top.

title: Beef Mince Stuffed Peppers
teaser: Bell peppers filled with a savoury mince and rice mixture, baked until tender.
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C (fan 170°C).
Fry the onion and mince until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the rice, half the tomatoes, and the oregano.
Spoon the mixture into the peppers and place in an ovenproof dish. Pour the remaining tomatoes around them.
Top with cheese and bake for 25-30 minutes until the peppers are tender.

title: Mince & Onion Pasta Bake
teaser: A baked pasta dish with a rich mince sauce and melted cheese on top.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Cook the pasta until just tender and drain.
Fry the onion and mince until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomatoes and herbs and simmer for 10 minutes.
Mix the pasta through the sauce, transfer to an ovenproof dish, top with cheese, and bake for 15-20 minutes until golden.

title: Chicken Parmesan Bake
teaser: Breaded chicken baked under tomato sauce and melted cheese.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Dip the chicken in the egg, then coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry in a little oil for 3-4 minutes per side until golden (it doesn't need to be fully cooked through yet).
Place in an ovenproof dish, spoon over the tomatoes and oregano, and top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the cheese is bubbling.

title: Lamb Mince Shepherd's Pie
teaser: The classic mashed-potato-topped bake, made with lamb mince for a slightly richer flavour.
steps: Boil the potatoes until soft, about 15 minutes, then drain and mash with the butter and milk.
Fry the onion and carrots in a little oil for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomato purée and stock and simmer for 12-15 minutes until thickened.
Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C). Spoon the mince into an ovenproof dish, top with the mash, and bake for 20 minutes until golden.

title: Beef Mince Lasagne
teaser: A weeknight-sized lasagne — not quick, but mostly hands-off once it's in the oven.

ingredients.item: cheese sauce (from a jar, or butter, flour, and milk with cheddar stirred through)

steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C (fan 170°C).
Fry the onion and mince until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes.
In an ovenproof dish, layer mince sauce, lasagne sheets, and cheese sauce, repeating until you run out, finishing with cheese sauce on top.
Scatter with the grated cheddar and bake for 30-35 minutes until golden and the pasta is tender.

title: Chicken & Leek Filo Pie
teaser: A comforting pie with a creamy chicken and leek filling wrapped in crisp filo pastry.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Melt the butter in a large pan and cook the leeks over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the chicken and cook for 5-6 minutes until browned.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then gradually add the chicken stock, stirring until thickened.
Stir in the cream and Dijon mustard, season with salt and pepper, and transfer to a baking dish.
Scrunch the filo sheets and arrange over the top of the filling, brushing with melted butter.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until the filo is golden and crisp.

title: Spinach & Feta Filo Pie
teaser: A vegetarian filo pie with a creamy spinach and feta filling.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Heat the olive oil in a large pan and soften the onion for 4-5 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook for 2-3 minutes until wilted, then remove from the heat and let cool slightly.
Stir in the feta, eggs, and dill, and season with salt and pepper.
Transfer to a baking dish and scrunch the filo sheets over the top, brushing with melted butter.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until the filo is golden and crisp.

title: Salmon Fishcakes
teaser: Homemade fishcakes using tinned or cooked salmon and mashed potato.
steps: Mix the mashed potato, salmon, and spring onions together, and season well.
Shape into 4-6 patties.
Dip each patty in the beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry in a little oil for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and heated through.

title: Loaded Baked Potato Bar
teaser: Jacket potatoes microwaved until soft then crisped in the oven, topped with your choice of cheese, beans, and soured cream.
steps: Prick the potatoes all over with a fork and microwave on high for 10-12 minutes until mostly soft.
Rub the skins with olive oil and a little salt, then transfer to a hot oven (220°C/fan 200°C) for 15-20 minutes until the skins are crisp.
Meanwhile, warm the baked beans in a small pan.
Split the potatoes open and fluff the inside with a fork.
Top with the baked beans, cheddar, soured cream, and spring onion, and finish with black pepper.
